name: MVGS_CS_GRZ_SEQUENCING_LAYOUT
title: MV-GenomSeq GRZ sequencing layout
description: BfArM GRZ donors[].labData[].sequencingLayout (end type of the sequencing reads). Used as the value of mii-ex-mtb-genomic-study-analysis-qc.extension:sequencing-read-type, which has no binding (DISCUSS-TD #22).

concept.definition: Reads are sequenced from one end of the fragment.
Reads are sequenced from both ends of the fragment.
Reads are sequenced from the reverse strand only.
